images.alt: Зеленый лес по краю вулканического провала Лос-Гемелос — иллюстрация
images.prompt: Photorealistic editorial illustration wide 16:9 premium travel hero of Los Gemelos sinkholes in highlands of Santa Cruz Galapagos Ecuador. View from rim of ONE large deep almost circular collapsed volcanic pit, sheer dark gray volcanic cliff walls partly overgrown with green ferns and shrubs, dense native Scalesia woodland along rim and bottom. Moist pale highland clouds, lightly misty depth, lush trees with small leaves and moss not giant jungle palms. No water inside pit, no lake, no smoking volcano, no huge mountains or two perfect craters side by side. Natural trail glimpsed at right near rim, lush geological depression right of center, soft daylight, no people text watermark collage.
